paragraphs.label: Mở thư và lời khuyên
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for your email. I am glad you told me about your interest in smartphones in the classroom. You asked for advice, so I have a few suggestions that you might find helpful. You do not need to do everything at once.

Thanks for your email. I am glad you told me about your interest in [chủ đề]. You asked for advice, so I have a few suggestions that you might find helpful. You do not need to do everything at once.

paragraphs.label: Gợi ý đầu
paragraphs.text: If I were you, I would start by joining a digital learning workshop. There, you could try a phone-based research task and discuss classroom rules. This could be useful because students can quickly access useful learning material. For example, a class can compare two digital maps to explain how a neighbourhood has changed.
